title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Hasmukh D. Suthar on 25.09.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 24/09/2026
It is hereby notified that on 25.09.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 24/09/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-06/2026
It is hereby notified that on 25.09.2026 ;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hasmukh D. Suthar would not be
available for Judicial as well as Administrative work.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev J.
Thaker) would take up the matters notified in the Cause
list of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Hasmukh D. Suthar.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
